status_summary: The staff vaccination mandate was withdrawn before the period: CMS published a final rule on 2023-06-05, effective 2023-08-04, removing the requirements, so the nonenforcement and revocation items were satisfied before 2025-01-20 and are not counted. Since the period began, CMS has removed the COVID-19 vaccination coverage among health care personnel reporting measure from quality programs, starting with the FY 2026 hospital inpatient final rule published 2025-08-04, a parallel step away from tracking staff vaccination. No CMS action on damages for dismissed workers and no CMS facility mask mandate was found.

timeline.event: CMS published the FY 2026 hospital inpatient and long-term care hospital payment final rule (effective 2025-10-01), which removes the COVID-19 Vaccination Coverage among Healthcare Personnel measure from the Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting Program beginning with the CY 2024 reporting period.

title: End the CMS staff COVID-19 vaccine mandate, avoid mask mandates, pay dismissed workers
uncertainties: Mandate text on pages 475 and 476 was checked. The 2023 final rule (88 FR 36485) was read on the Federal Register host (page truncated at the end). The FY 2026 inpatient final rule (90 FR 36536, CMS-1833-F) was re-read on the Federal Register host in its executive summary, which confirms removal of the health care personnel COVID-19 vaccination measure from the Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting Program beginning with the CY 2024 reporting period; the body of the removal section (X.C.4.b) was not displayed in the web version. A Federal Register API query found seven payment rules since 2025-01-20 that discuss the measure; removals from other programs (outpatient, ambulatory surgical center, psychiatric, rehabilitation, skilled nursing) were seen only in search excerpts and are not listed as events. Two web searches on reinstatement, back pay or damages for health care workers returned nothing relevant to CMS, so absence of a damages step rests on a limited search. The measure is a reporting measure, not a vaccination requirement, which is why the match is parallel. Records c04-02 (military reinstatement) and c00-21 (Foreword mask and vaccine item) cover related items.
